summary: Pin is steep bush; the mapped car park by the roundabout suits a van.
reasons: Mapped free car park with cars
Off the road, clear of lane

best_section.where: Asphalt car park at the lower-right edge of the image, about 90 m east-south-east of the pin, past the roundabout

drivers.seclusion: Bush on all sides; no buildings in the data or imagery.
drivers.access_and_room: Asphalt car park off the roundabout, access yes, no fee, with cars parked in both images. The road at the pin has no shoulder.

drivers.convention: Several cars parked in the car park; it is a public car park.
